compilerSourceStatus.classification: Current C23 CLI source set; not ratified as canonical self-hosting source.

assembly.behavior: Python read_text(UTF-8, universal newlines), concatenate in listed order with one LF, open as one metadata-only OCaml session document.
assembly.measurement: Statically recomputed from the sources and compact JSON encoding; not sent to a live compiler.

operationTrace.owner: pep.ps1 + Python driver; OCaml seed process
operationTrace.does: Dispatch build-c23/run-c23, assemble/register Pep sources; start session --jsonl.
operationTrace.boundary: PowerShell launches Python; Python frames messages; OCaml is the seed host. No Pep parse/check semantics here.

operationTrace.owner: Pep lexer/parser/checker/emitter executed by OCaml interpreter
operationTrace.does: Open metadata-only bundle; register parser_parse_program, analyze_parsed, emit_c23_checked; validate fixed vectors and activate emitter.
operationTrace.boundary: OCaml host parses/checks the bundle and owns the tool registry; invoked bodies are Pep functions.
operationTrace.evidence: pep_c23.py and implementation sources inspected; no session run.

operationTrace.does: Python reads raw bytes and sends unsigned-byte array via open_bytes; host assigns document/revision; v2 semanticTarget carries that identity.
operationTrace.boundary: Python does file I/O/framing, not language parsing; Pep source_bytes is host-authorized.
Pep functions interpreted by OCaml during typed tool invocation.
Pep parser runs in OCaml interpreter; driver uses one-shot entry, not parser_start/parser_step.
Pep checker runs in OCaml interpreter and receives parser result plus host target revision.
Pep emitter runs in OCaml interpreter and checks parsed/checker document and revision against host semantic snapshot.

operationTrace.owner: Python driver + selected external Clang/GCC + OS
operationTrace.does: Write generated C as UTF-8/LF, invoke -std=c23 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -O2; run-c23 executes output.
operationTrace.boundary: External toolchain/OS performs compilation and execution, outside Pep semantics.
operationTrace.evidence: Static inspection only; Windows Defender hold prevents native generation/build/run.

sourceBytes.scope: open_bytes input; rejects longer arrays as PEP_SOURCE_BYTE_LIMIT

typedValue.scope: v2 typed argument/result traversal and semantic result construction

ordinaryInterpreter.scope: ordinary Pep execution; separate from tool limits; source-advertised, not measured

baselineAndLimits.reason: Native test suites may compile and execute generated C23 binaries; no tests or compiler session were launched.
baselineAndLimits.conclusion: The explicit raw source cap is 65536 bytes. The current compiler bundle is 294153 normalized UTF-8 bytes and its compact open request is about 303899 bytes, below the framing cap by static recomputation only. This does not show the bundle opens or a target fits parser/checker fuel or typed-result limits.
unknowns: No clean OCaml build in this slice.
No parser/checker/emitter fuel profile or small/large execution baseline.
Agent 2 emitter/runtime evidence remains in its own lane.

authorityAndCompatibility.revisions: Compiler-bundle revision and host-selected target document/revision are distinct; tool invocation names the authorized semanticTarget.
authorityAndCompatibility.protocols: OCaml seed advertises v1/v2; current C23 driver uses typed tool protocol v2.
authorityAndCompatibility.security: Host is trusted-local, not a sandbox. No authority boundary change proposed.
authorityAndCompatibility.acceptance: No master, CURRENT.md, manifest.json, or milestone-status changes.
